description: This file implements the software side of interrupt request (IRQ) handling for a POSIX-based Zephyr environment, including IRQ vector management, interrupt handling, priority setting, and IRQ offloading.

methods.name: vector_to_irq
methods.description: Handles dispatching of IRQs based on vector table, manages direct and normal IRQs, and performs context switching if needed.

methods.name: posix_irq_handler
methods.description: Main IRQ handler that processes pending IRQs, manages nested IRQs, and performs thread switching.

methods.name: posix_irq_handler_im_from_sw
methods.description: Handles software-triggered immediate IRQs, invoking the main IRQ handler if higher priority IRQs are pending.

methods.name: posix_irq_lock
methods.description: Disables all interrupts on the CPU and returns a lock key.

methods.name: posix_irq_unlock
methods.description: Re-enables interrupts using the provided lock key.

methods.name: posix_irq_full_unlock
methods.description: Re-enables all interrupts, clearing any lock.

methods.name: posix_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ line is enabled.

methods.name: posix_get_current_irq
methods.description: Returns the currently running IRQ number.

methods.name: posix_isr_declare
methods.description: Configures a static interrupt, setting its handler, parameter, and flags.

methods.name: posix_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority of a specific IRQ.

methods.name: posix_sw_set_pending_IRQ
methods.description: Sets a software pending IRQ, causing an immediate interrupt if unmasked.

methods.name: posix_sw_clear_pending_IRQ
methods.description: Clears a pending IRQ from software.

methods.name: posix_irq_offload
methods.description: Runs a function in interrupt context by offloading via a software IRQ.
